Joe Serrins Studio is looking to add a project architect to our team. We are a boutique architecture and design firm based in New York with a focus on single family, modern residential projects. Current commissions include new builds in Miami and Santa Barbara, as well as townhouses, penthouses, and new homes in NY, Aspen, and abroad.
The ideal candidate has experience as a project architect / team captain in the creation of high-end single family residences. We’re looking for a person who is both inventive and a skilled project manager, with an eye for contemporary design and detailing, and a love of making and drawing. We can offer you a studio that promotes career growth within the firm, impressive clientele with well-funded projects, and a healthy life/work balance alongside a talented team of like-minded architects and designers.
Applicant requirements:
- 5-8 years experience
- ability to manage a junior architect and organize a project team
- ability to organize and draw construction documents in AutoCAD
- REVIT experience
- skilled in SketchUp, Lumion, and other rendering software
- experience with Adobe Suite
- experience with NYC DoB code and expeditors
- experience with residential construction methods
- experience coordinating and communicating with contractors and consultants
- You are organized and thorough, with an ability to handle multiple projects at various stages of development and construction.
- You are a skilled designer with a sensitivity for modern residential detailing and passion for your work.
- You are legally able to work in the US without sponsorship.
Compensation and Benefits:
- $90,000-$128,000 annual salary
- Annual salary review and bonus opportunities
- Paid vacation days, holidays, sick days
- Retirement plan 401(k)
- Oxford UHC health insurance
- Option to WFH one day per week
Position currently available. Note, this is an in-person position, 4-5 days per week. Please submit resume, work samples, and salary’s requirements to our email at [email protected] Thank you! - Joe
